ev.q: Since October, 42 influenza-associated deaths among children aged <18 years have been reported to CDC.
Seventeen (40%) of the children had underlying chronic medical conditions
Among the 42 reported deaths, 20 (48%) patients were male, and 21 (50%) were female
Twenty-three (55%) of the children were aged <5 years
Among the 21 patients who had no underlying chronic medical condition, five had invasive bacterial co-infections
This report describes preliminary findings based on data provided from multiple states
